cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let work ring. I'd like to finish choosing our wedding vows with you. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The client won't sign unless I'm there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'm about to promise you my whole life. Could I have ten minutes before the client?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask Maya to cover. She'll want a reason.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her we're making promises too. Put ours in your calendar beside the client's.

mechanism: A directs wedding planning but reduces duration and helps B delegate work so B prioritizes their promise over a client demand.
confusable: Unlike mere scheduling convenience, A explicitly seeks relational priority; borrowed authority adapts the practical plan to keep B participating.
comparison: Wedding vows and client cover differ from a home dinner competing with promotion networking.
seedUse: Use D82-a vows/client/Maya/calendar and S02-a flexible timing under a confident plan.
